rules: Owner decisions D01-D34 are fixed requirements, not recorded H-gate approvals.
All H0-H7 approval decisions belong to the project owner; no agent self-approval.
Physical implementation stays app/modules; require safe importable namespace plus FastAPI.
T09 paper figures and required Tiled Graph implementation must complete before T12/H4.
All inference/QA behavior must preserve the actual F2W rsoxs classes and constraints.
No new Splash backend or experimental sim/analysis capabilities enter F2W.
T17 covers all donor paper infrastructure/routes/operators and closes before H6.
No paid/model-provider escalation or production mutation without explicit scoped authorization.
Prototype FORGE/API integration against mocks after H1; real SDK/agent/API parity requires listed dependencies.
F2W migration commits integrate on forge_merge; no direct changes to main/rsoxs, no fabricated ZIP history.
T18A freezes UI contracts before H1, T18B tests the frozen UI with the runtime before H2, T18C full real-backend parity blocks H6.
Existing F2W ops/MP/live lookup and source/multi-KG retrieval remain baseline compatibility obligations; donor sim/analysis stays excluded.
Legacy splash/splash_links wire values require a reviewed Tiled compatibility projection, not a running Splash service or dropped editing.
T19A-T19E integrates reusable Knowledge Operations; no arbitrary script/Python execution.
Both managed and external Tiled Graph modes are mandatory; T20B supplies disposable application-owned test provisioning.
Tiled required owner permissions are owner-confirmed; exact pinned build/configuration and integration checks remain evidence requirements.
T11 implements required binary extraction/chat acceptance, not only gold metrics or aggregate thresholds.
Frontend-selected F2W model settings and configured/provider limits apply to all callers; no hidden donor/paid fallback or invented dollar cap.
T21 enforces agent-private full paper/figure access; public UI/API/trace/graph/report outputs use safe projections.
KG creation produces immutable versioned JSON artifacts using preserved F2W logic, independently of Tiled.
The required Tiled 0.2.19 importer consumes approved JSON without parser, inference or provider calls.
Preserve current schema meanings including RSoXSMeasurement inheritance; no semantic split in this migration.
Permit relevant exact cited quotations; forbid complete paper/source-crop serving and raw-source reconstruction.
Tiled target is exactly 0.2.19; resolve artifact hashes and capabilities, never silently substitute a prerelease/latest.
O03 awaits owner confirmation after the source audit; generation settings capture is distinct from live rate/auth controls.
Snapshot re-import must not erase acknowledged UI edits; reconcile durable edits into the next JSON version.
GitHub Actions must build/test/publish local, als-dev and als-prod image variants; approved promotion is separate from Ansible rollout.
Every image serves /fair2wise; the API gateway strips its reviewed prefix once and frontend build configuration agrees.
Local includes managed Tiled; ALS finals have no managed server and target staging/prod respectively without fallback or replication.
Papers, private derived content and state are mounted at runtime, never image layers or CI caches.
F2W imports JSON using an admin account; application authorization and distinct request/approval/execution audit remain mandatory.
O05 is resolved by D30/D34: local full access without sign-in; ALS admin-only writes; preserve real edit behavior and audit.
Ansible resolves ALS FQDN, secret/mount/proxy settings and digest rollout; actual backup details must be settled before H7.
D34 local_trusted grants all application capabilities without sign-in. D30 uses Tiled identity/admin authority on ALS, with ordinary users chat-only. Technical writer is separate.
Committed JSON/data commit is independent of code image digest and Tiled target receipt.
FORGE remote branch and merge are coordinated by project owner with Alex; no target branch inferred.
